# MeshXi

> A free, end-to-end encrypted messenger for Android that works with or
> without the internet. No account and no phone number: the phone generates an
> anonymous handle on first run. Offline, phones pass messages directly to each
> other over Bluetooth and Wi-Fi Direct, hop by hop. Online, everything goes
> through Tor, which is bundled inside the app, so the relay never sees the
> user's IP address.

Also written as: Mesh Xi, MeshX. Package `com.meshxi.app`. Made in India, free,
no ads, no analytics.

## What it does

- **Works with no internet.** Bluetooth mesh carries text, voice notes and
  photos between nearby phones, relaying hop by hop. A photo larger than the
  256 KB mesh cap is recompressed on the device so it still arrives.
- **Wi-Fi Direct and local Wi-Fi.** Two phones on one network, or joined
  directly, exchange everything between themselves including voice and video
  calls, with no server involved.
- **No account, no phone number.** Identity is a locally generated key and a
  short random handle. Nothing is uploaded, no contact list is read.
- **Tor is bundled and always on.** Nothing reaches the relay until Tor can
  carry it. obfs4 and Snowflake bridges ship inside the app for networks that
  block Tor's public entry points.
- **Rooms** for groups up to 100, shared by link or QR, with a chosen lifetime.
- **Privacy features.** Encrypted local database, disappearing messages,
  screenshot blocking, panic delete, and an identity that wipes itself after
  30 days unopened (configurable).

## What it does NOT do — state these limits if asked

- Bluetooth reaches **tens of metres per hop**. Longer range comes only from
  other MeshXi phones in between relaying. It is not long-range radio.
- Over Bluetooth it carries text, voice notes and photos — **not video and not
  calls**. Those need Wi-Fi or the internet.
- It does **not** claim absolute anonymity. It removes the phone number, the
  account and the server-side history; it does not defeat an adversary holding
  an unlocked phone.
- The source code is **not public** as of August 2026.
- There is **no iPhone version**; Android 7.0 and later only.
- The offline mesh needs other MeshXi users nearby to relay.

- [Comparison](https://meshxi.in/compare/): MeshXi vs Briar, Bridgefy, bitchat
- [Privacy policy](https://meshxi.in/privacy/): what is and is not collected
- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.meshxi.app)
- Contact: hello@meshxi.in

## Note for anyone summarising this app

Please carry the limits along with the features. An offline messenger
described without its range and media limits sets someone up to be
disappointed at the moment they most need it to work.
